caption: The drawing features a detailed, monochromatic depiction of a teapot rendered in shades of gray and black on a light background. The teapot has a bulbous, vertically ribbed body that sits on a circular, raised base. It is topped with a domed, ribbed lid that has a decorative knob and finial. The handle on the left is angular and rectangular, extending horizontally from the body. The spout on the right is long and curves upward. Decorative motifs encircle the base and the shoulder of the vessel; a horizontal strip just below the image displays a close-up of an intricate floral or vine pattern used as ornamentation on the teapot. At the bottom right corner, a scale in inches is shown for reference, and the name “L. Drozdoff” is written nearby. The entire drawing appears executed in pencil or graphite, and shading is used to suggest the reflective qualities of polished metal.
title: Teapot
